Innerhalb von Kelvion kommt die Kreativität zum Vorschein, weil den Menschen zugehört wird, ihre Beiträge anerkannt und ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen werden. Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

jobs.occupation: Senior Analyst Curve Modelling und Governance (f/m/d) (Wertpapieranalyst/in)
jobs.description: E.ON Energy Markets GmbH (EEM) is a subsidiary of the E.ON Group based in Essen. We provide the E.ON Group’s regional business units with access to wholesale energy markets and manage the associated opportunities and risks. Our expertise spans portfolio strategies, risk management and data-driven services. Working across several European countries, we connect regional business needs with European energy markets.At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.Ready to become a Playmaker? Join our team and apply online. Are you brave enough to forge new paths and create a real impact? We can't wait to meet you. It's on us to make new energy work.ResponsibilitiesQuantitative Ownership und Methodological Leadership • Design, evolve and maintain group-wide PFC methodologies, standards and principles • Independently challenge assumptions, parameter choices and expert judgement used in curve construction • Perform model reviews, validation, back-testing and sensitivity analyses; assess model limitations and suitability for use Market Analysis und Curve Quality • Monitor market developments, liquidity conditions, structural changes and assess implications for curve construction • Define and maintain quantitative curve quality metrics and monitoring frameworks Governance, Stakeholder Management und Decision Support • Act as the central interface between local curve owners, quantitative analysts, trading desks, risk management and senior management • Coordinate and prioritise developments across quantitative and technical teams,steering central technical resources towards the highest-value • Coordinate regular curve approval and update cycles Implementation und Data / Reporting Enablement • Support local teams and quantitative developers in the implementation of price models in a modern, cloud-native tech stack • Develop and enhance analytical and reporting solutions for energy trading, portfolio management and risk management  Qualifications• Master’s degree (or PhD) in Finance, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics or related field • 5–7+ years experience in quantitative modelling, forward curve construction or energy markets (analytics, trading or risk management) • Strong foundation in statistics, stochastic modelling and time‑series analysis • Advanced Python skills, including the ability to read, understand and review model code; solid experience working with databases and modern data / cloud platforms • Proven ability to challenge assumptions constructively and pragmatically • Strong communication skills, able to translate complex quantitative topics into clear, management ready messages • Comfortable operating in fast paced environments, managing multiple stakeholders and driving topics independently• Fluent in English; confident presenting to senior and non‑quantitative stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Global Application Owner (f/m/d) - Field Performance Testing (Ingenieur/in - Mechanik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as a Global Application Owner (f/m/d) for Field Performance Testing, where you will play a pivotal role in managing business-critical software applications that support our global Field Performance Testing activities. Imagine working at the intersection of engineering, IT, and software development, ensuring the reliable operation and continuous improvement of existing applications while driving the digitalization of FPT workflows. Collaborate with both internal and external development partners to translate engineering needs into sustainable digital solutions, supporting their development throughout the entire application lifecycle. By taking dedicated ownership of these applications, you will help ensure business continuity, allowing our FPT engineers to focus on customer projects and their core engineering responsibilities.How You’ll Make an Impact * Own and manage business-critical Field Performance Testing (FPT) applications globally* Ensure reliable operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management across international locations* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives to improve efficiency, standardization, and user experience* Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective software solutions* Develop and enhance FPT applications while coordinating with internal teams and external partners* Support testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to ensure application stability and business continuityWhat You Bring* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field* Experience in software development, application management, digitalization, or IT project environments* Strong hands-on skills in programming, databases, scripting, and business application technologies (e.g., Azure, Power Platform, Python, SQL, GitHub)* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, particularly using GitLab and GitLab Runner* Knowledge of Machine Learning and its application in digital automation and workflow optimization* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in an international environment; fluent English required, German is a plusAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO

Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.At the Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS), the Department for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden) offers, subject to the availability of resources, two project positions funded by the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) asResearch Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting as soon as possible. The positions are fixed-term until January 31, 2029. An extension may be possible subject to the availability of resources. The period of employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz – WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement.In the COANDRI cooperation project, an innovative framework is to be developed that enables flexible and vendor-independent integration of a wide variety of robotic systems. At its core are five essential building blocks: First, a unified capability abstraction will be created to ensure universal connectivity of diverse systems. Second, the framework relies on declarative, versioned, and combinable skills organized in an API-like architecture. Third, COANDRI enables self-service authoring based on LLM and VLM reasoning, patented tactile-sensing hardware, and AI-assisted skill capture using smart glasses and a voice agent. Fourth, secure AI inference in a closed control loop based on Tactile Internet and 6G ensures real-time capability. Fifth, semantic modeling as a knowledge graph with long-term memory is implemented to enable adaptive and explainable skill selection. The project aims to validate the framework and the resulting robot skills on three humanoid research platforms and at least two classes of mobile robots under laboratory conditions (TRL 4). Validation covers four scenarios: hospital service tasks, mobile workshop logistics, electronics and battery assembly, and banking services.Professional assignment:Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael Färber)Research areas:Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)Tasks: - scientific research and development activities in at least one of the above-mentioned research areas- conducting scientific research activities within the COANDRI project- preparation of publications in internationally renowned journals and presentation of research findings at conferencesRequirements: - a university degree (M.Sc., M.Eng., Diploma or equivalent) and, if applicable, PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Systems, Data Science, Computational Science, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Information Science, Information Systems, Information Systems Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, Computational Linguistics, Digital Humanities, Linguistics, or a related field- a strong interest in fundamental research in the above-mentioned fields- strong programming skills, preferably in Python, including experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) and related tools- very good written and spoken English- strong analytical and problem-solving skills- high level of motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team- research experience (publications, theses, projects) in the above-mentioned research areas is a major advantageWe offer:The position comes with access to high-performance computing resources and access to training opportunities within ScaDS.AI.TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research.
